name: Finance Payments API
shortDescription: Deterministic payments math — installment/amortization, processor fee split + gross-up, exact multi-party settlement (sums to the penny)
description: Agent-native payments math computed in real arithmetic — no LLM. /installment amortizes a loan (monthly payment, total interest, total paid, schedule). /fee-split computes a processor fee (percent + fixed), net settlement, effective fee %, and an optional gross-up (what to charge to net a target). /settlement splits an amount across parties by weight or share % using largest-remainder allocation that sums exactly to the penny. The one-call /lookup amortizes and applies an optional per-payment processor fee, with reasoning. Confidence 1.0; informational, not financial advice.
